title: Before Your Vaccines
about: Questions to ask before giving vaccines, written for this library from the contraindications and precautions in ACIP's General Best Practices Guidelines for Immunization (Table 4-1, July 25, 2024) and its timing and spacing rules. A yes does not always mean no vaccine: staff check each yes against ACIP's table for each vaccine. The table predates COVID-19, RSV and mpox vaccines, which have their own CDC guidance.

source.name: Written for Clinic Forms, from ACIP's General Best Practices Guidelines for Immunization, Contraindications and Precautions, Table 4-1 (July 25, 2024)

blocks.text: Please answer these questions for the person getting vaccines today. If you are filling this in for a child, answer for the child.

blocks.label: For everyone
items: Are you sick today?
Have you ever had a severe allergic reaction (hives, a swollen face or throat, trouble breathing) after a vaccine, or to anything in a vaccine, such as yeast, latex or gelatin?
Within 7 days of a whooping cough (pertussis) vaccine, have you ever had a coma, a long seizure or a long time of confusion?
Have you ever had Guillain-Barre syndrome?
Have you ever had very large, painful swelling where a tetanus or diphtheria shot was given?
Do you have a weakened immune system from a disease like HIV or cancer, or from treatment like chemotherapy, radiation, transplant medicine or high-dose steroids?
Was a parent, brother or sister born with a problem of the immune system?
Are you pregnant, or could you become pregnant in the next month?
In the past year, have you had a blood transfusion, blood products, or a medicine called immune globulin?
Have you ever had a low platelet count (thrombocytopenia)?
Do you have a brain or nerve problem that is getting worse, or seizures that are not controlled?
In the past day, have you taken acyclovir, famciclovir or valacyclovir (medicines for herpes or shingles)?
Do you take aspirin or another salicylate every day?
Have you had any vaccine in the past 4 weeks?
Do you need a TB skin test or TB blood test soon?

blocks.label: For babies and young children
items: Has your child ever had intussusception, a kind of bowel blockage?
Is your child age 2 to 4 and has had asthma or wheezing in the past 12 months?

blocks.label: Only for the nasal spray flu vaccine
items: In the past 3 weeks, have you taken a flu medicine (oseltamivir, zanamivir, peramivir or baloxavir)?
Do you have a cochlear implant, or a leak of spinal fluid?
Do you have no spleen, or a spleen that does not work?
Do you live with or care for someone whose immune system is so weak they must stay in a protected room?

blocks.label: For each yes: what was found, and the vaccine it affects (ACIP Table 4-1)
